_README: TEMPLATE ONLY -- this tracked file contains NO real data and is NEVER read by
a build. To use it: copy it to `.private_targets.json` (note the LEADING DOT)
in this same folder and replace every <placeholder> with your own real value.
That dotted filename is gitignored, so it never leaves your machine.
WHAT IT IS FOR: build_complete_public_release.py and check_private_data.py
scrub and then audit a release for YOUR private data. That data is NEVER
hardcoded anywhere in this repository -- which is exactly why the list has to
come from you.
YOU DO NOT NEED THIS FILE TO BUILD A PUBLIC RELEASE. A fresh clone holds no
private data, so the builder's PRIVACY PRE-FLIGHT sees a pristine tree and
builds in CLEAN-TREE mode. It only INSISTS on a list when it finds evidence
that this particular tree can leak (a data.keys vault, keyed config files, a
contacts book, root *.key files) -- i.e. when skipping the scrub would
actually publish something.
TWO RULES THAT KEEP THIS FILE HARMLESS:
1. Keys starting with `_` are documentation and are ignored as targets.
2. <angle-bracket> values are recognised as placeholders and dropped, so an
unfilled copy behaves like 'no list given' instead of quietly passing a
build that scrubbed nothing real.
A plain newline-separated list of values works too, if you prefer that to JSON.
Angela's display name and her @angelahack1 handle are ALWAYS kept in every
build and must never be listed here.
names: <a legal-name variant of yours that should not ship, e.g. a middle name>
emails: <any older address of yours that may still be in the tree>
handles: <a messaging handle of yours that is not @angelahack1>
